inputs.xtext_rule_text:
OwnedSubsetting returns SysML::Subsetting :
	  subsettedFeature = [SysML::Feature|QualifiedName]
	| ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain
;

decision: As SysML 8.2.2.6.5 states it: `subsettedFeature = [QualifiedName]`, or `subsettedFeature = OwnedFeatureChain` with the chain owned by the relationship. The cross-reference parses a QualifiedName. The `{ ownedRelatedElement += ... }` action consumes no tokens. This is the SysML variant (ADR-0014). The Xtext states the same two alternatives.

evidence.note: OwnedSubsetting : Subsetting = subsettedFeature = [QualifiedName] | subsettedFeature = OwnedFeatureChain { ownedRelatedElement += ... }

evidence.ref: vendor/corpus/sysml/src/examples/v1 Spec Examples/8.4.1 Wheel Hub Assembly/Wheel Package - Updated.sysml

OwnedSubsetting: subsettedFeature = [SysML::... | QualifiedName] | ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain. Agrees.
